description: This file defines the SuiteLogger class, a PSR-3 compliant logger implementation within the SuiteCRM utility namespace. It includes methods for logging messages at various levels and interpolating context into messages.

classes.name: SuiteLogger
classes.description: A PSR-3 compliant logger class that extends AbstractLogger and provides logging functionality with level-based message handling.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs a message at a specified level, interpolating context variables into the message.

methods.name: interpolate
methods.description: Replaces placeholders in the message with corresponding context values.
